claim_boundaries: A state detector is not automatically a future-demography warning.
The Ya Ha Tinda primary is a sample-overlap STOP, not a positive or negative spatial-early-warning test.
The Ya Ha Tinda panel sensitivity is a measurement uncertainty result conditional on monitored collars, not a full-herd or demographic result.
Mac Hugh measures annual route-longitude variance, not instantaneous inter-individual-distance CV.
The original Ya Ha Tinda 11-year requirement is a fixed experiment-specific rule, not a general requirement for other systems.
Bathurst and Central Arctic are feasibility leads, not admitted prospective analyses; permissions and same-unit future endpoints must be verified before fitting.
